visualCharacteristics: Horizontal row of tab buttons above a content panel. The selected tab is marked with a brand-accent underline; clicking a tab switches the visible panel. One panel is shown at a time.
contentPattern: Each row has two cells: [ tab label | panel content ]. The first cell becomes the tab button; the row becomes the associated panel.
usage: Switchable panels such as testimonial sets or grouped content. Used by the homepage-landing testimonial section.
